configurations.name: storybook
runtimeArgs: cd ui && PAPERCLIP_STORYBOOK_API_URL=http://localhost:3121 bun x --bun --no-install storybook dev -p 6016 -c storybook/.storybook --no-open --ci

configurations.name: artifact-directions-dev
runtimeArgs: cd ui && bun x --bun --no-install vp --config vite.artifact-directions.config.mjs --port 5180 --strictPort

configurations.name: artifact-directions
runtimeArgs: cd ui && export ARTIFACT_DIRECTIONS_OUT_DIR=node_modules/.artifact-directions-dist && bun x --bun --no-install vp build --config vite.artifact-directions.config.mjs && bun x --bun --no-install vp preview --config vite.artifact-directions.config.mjs --port 5190 --strictPort
